result_summary.title: MFA Manager timeouts affecting US-West production
result_summary.description: Users in our US-West production environment are experiencing upstream dependency timeouts when using MFA Manager. This issue has a high business impact and is currently affecting 215 users. We need assistance resolving these timeout issues promptly.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the upstream dependency configuration and check for any recent changes that may have caused the issue.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case is related to an upstream dependency problem with the MFA Manager, which is causing timeouts for users in the US-West production environment. The evidence suggests that there have been previous health events and availability dips on the Authentication Service, which may be related to the current issue.
